tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon po lha lnga'i dbang bshad bzhugs so// 'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po zhes grags pa 'di/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud gang las gsungs na gtso bor mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi le'u bco lnga pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las rdo rje nag po chen po 'di nyid phyung ngo / /hūm̐ gi yi ge las skyes pa/ zhes sogs kyi bar gsungs la/ mgon po mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ mgon po phyag gnyis pa nas/ phyag 'bum pa'i bar gyi sgrub thabs gsungs pa las/ phyag gnyis pa 'di nyid rgyas par bstan pa yin cing / dur khrod nag po'i rgyud las lha lnga ma/ lha bcu gnyis ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur tshul dang / sgrub thabs rgya cher bshad/ rgyud de dag la brten nas rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la mgon po'i bka' babs rnam pa bzhi bzhugs te/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra nas 'brog mi lo tsā ba las brgyud pa dpa' rkyang gi rjes gnang sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje nas ba ri lo tsā ba las brgyud pa mgon po rkyang pa'i rjes gnang dang / paṇ+ḍi ta shrad+dhā kā ra warma nas lo rin chen bzang po dang mal lo tsā ba las brgyud pa mgon po lha bcu gnyis/ lha brgyad/ lha lnga rnams kyi dbang bskur pa dang / lcam dral lha brgyad/ bcu gnyis ma 'khor rkyang rnams kyi rjes gnang phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa shin tu rgyas par bzhugs pa dang / kha che paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī las brgyud de chos rje sa skya paṇa chen gyis gsan pa'i gsang bsgrub spu gri skor gsum zhes grags pa rnams yin la/ de yang lugs dang po gnyis dang phyi ma ni pho rkyang du sgrub pa'i las tshogs cung zad ma gtogs rgya cher mi snang zhing / mal lugs zhes grags pa 'di nyid la sgrub tshul gyi rnam par bzhag pa rab tu mang po bzhugs na yang phyi bsgrub la tshogs dag dang bka' stod ltar sgrub pa gang yin yang /

rkyang du bsgrub pa dang / sbags te bsgrub pa gnyis/ dang po la pho rkyang / mo rkang / 'khor rkang du bsgrub pa gsum yod la/ gnyis pa la lcam dral/ lha brgyad/ lha bcu gnyis/ lha bcu bdun sbags te bsgrub pa la sogs pa las/ 'dir gur gyi mgon po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba bsgrub par byed pa las/ sngon 'gro sta gon gyi chos dang dngos bzhi dbang bskur gnyis las/ dang po la sa'i lha mo sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon rnams sngon du song / slob ma ston la chos rnam pa bcu gcig tu gnas pa lags/ 'di yang sa skya lo tsās bris//༄༅/ /bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa sku mched che 'don gnang dus/ sa skya lo tsā bas mdzad/swasti/ dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du bgyis na/ dri ma med pa'i 'od gsal 'chi med kyi gdung las nye bar 'khrungs pa'i 'khon dpal po ches/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po rje btsun rdo rje rnon po'i sprul pa khri srong lde btsan gyi nang blon mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun gyi nang nas mkhyen rab kyi dbang po mchog tu yangs pa klu'i dbang po bsrung ba dang / rigs sngags kyi nus pa mthar phyin pas log par 'dren pa'i dpung tshogs phye bar mdzad pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje rin chen nas legs par brgyud de/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ de'i dbon sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs bdun brgyud dang / byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po'i sprul pa 'gro ba'i mgon po phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa bla ma dam pa du ma'i rigs kyi sras gcig tu brgyud pa/ shar phyogs nor 'dzin skyong ba'i rgyal po ta'i mi yun los gtso mdzad/ skye dgu mang po smin grol la 'god par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang /

bdag chen bsod nams bkra shis gnyis kyi chos dang 'jig rten gyi rnam gzhag rmad du byung ba'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i dpal la 'gran par mdzad la/ de'i rigs kyi thig le bde legs bkra shis kyi sras/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan sku mched kyi bar du/ lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa ches ngo mtshar ba du mas snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba dpag tu med pa rnam par grol ba'i lam du 'jug pa lags/ de rnams thams cad kyi phrin las gcig tu spungs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po/ tshad med rin chen sna bzhi'i bang rim kun nas mdzes shing / mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i phyogs kyi mu khyud rab tu gsal bar mdzad pa'i phrin las rta bdun can dang ri bong 'dzin pa'i 'od zer rgya mtsho'i gos can gyi mtha' klas pa'i/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i ring lugs kha ba'i ljongs su ches cher rgyas pa'i phrin las kyi mnga' bdag chos kyi rje kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku mched kyis bstan pa'i rnam gzhag skabs gsum dbang po'i dpal 'byor/ zil gyi gnon par mdzad pa'i bkra shis dga' ston rgya chen por bsgrub pa'i skabs su/ gong nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par dag pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu lags// //bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal zhes grags pa'i rigs kyi sras bcu gsum byung ba la ma cig nyi ma rin chen la sras lcam sring gsum byung ba'i chung ba dbang kun dga' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos yab mes kyi chos mtha' dag legs par sbyangs/ rgyal po chen pos pa'i la'i dbang gi las kha dang / gser gyi dam kha/ shel gyi tho shu/ ging le'i khrims ra gnang nas sa chol kha gsum la shes su bcug ste/ khrims gnyis kyi bya ba la mnga' mdzad/ de'i btsun mo dge 'dun 'bum la sras gsum byung ba'i che ba bla chen bsod nams blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gzhon nu la rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas mdo rgyud bstan bcos dpag tu med pa la sbyangs shing /

chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rin chen sgang gi gdan sa gnang / gong ma rgyal pos gdan drangs ti shrī'i las kha phul te/ skye dgu mtha' dag smin grol la 'god par mdzad do/ /de'i gcung chung ba dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi btsun mo gnyis khab tu bzhes pa'i che ba la sras sku mched gnyis kyi che ba slob dpon chen po kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros dang / chung ba dbang rnam sras rgyal mtshan pa gnyis/ rnam sras rgyal mtshan la sras lcam mo gnyis dang / dbang nam mkha' legs pa/ de'i sras dbang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de la sras gnyis kyi che ba nam mkha' rin chen dang / chung ba dbang nam mkha' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gnyis/ chung ba la sras sku mched bzhi/ lcam mo kun dga' rgyal mo dang lnga 'khrungs pa'i che ba/ 'di yang sa skya lo tsā bas mdzad// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ mgon po lha lnga'i dbang bshad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
